# API Gateway 200 Providers

Gateway com 200 providers, 181 free_no_card, 14 free_no_key, 965 models, 50 adapters dedicados

## Run
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --reload
```

## Endpoints
- GET / — stats
- GET /providers — list
- POST /v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible
